purpose: Pins every input the recorded evidence rules out as a source for the class silhouette successor. The successor contract's fails_if names these; this file gives them exact identities so a later seat cannot reuse one by accident, and so the verifier can prove none was substituted into the frozen packet.

evidence_pin.why: The Hub rebuild 3e98769e removed review-approval-hub/evidence/** from the tree; origin/dev holds 0 files there. The packet bytes survive as git objects reachable from this commit. Every read below binds to a git object, never to a working-tree path, so this contract verifies the same bytes in any clone that has the objects — including one where the paths no longer exist.
evidence_pin.read_order: git_blob OID first (content-addressed, path-independent); 62f6867a:<path> as fallback when no OID is recorded.
